$comment: Single machine-owned source of bundle composition. Roles, fragment
membership, and byte caps live here and nowhere else; compile.sh reads
this file and nothing hardcodes a role or fragment.
Fragment order is load-bearing: a compiled bundle is the exact ordered
concatenation of the listed src/ files, and the manifest pins those bytes.
maxBytes caps keep the resident prompt small. A 39,415-token standing
prompt once cost ~$1.82 per run startup, 86% of it waste (22 turns
re-reading a prompt that cost ~$0.25 to write once). That incident is
why the caps exist: skills load per task, not all-resident.
